findings.summary: UI maps every SUCCEEDED run to verified ('Completed · verified'), so a GROUNDED run would be shown verified (PR-19).

open-pos is a CLI preset and scripted task kind with no scripted scenario: starting it on the fixture profile raises AttributeError and leaves the run RUNNING; qualify_model --task open-pos raises KeyError.
Grounded message.final is written before _succeed's gates; the bundle's grounded section keys on that event alone, not reason_code GROUNDED.
grounded.answer.v1 is not reserved in the registry; a plugin capability with that id would be silently taken over in a run pinned on (PR-09).
AcceptanceSpec.grounded_answer is always serialized, false included, so it appears in the on context pack's TASK layer.
explain.py does not render a grounded outcome yet (ADR 0033 §6).
test_eight_task_definitions_load_from_resources now loads 10; GROUNDED_ANSWER in contracts is acceptable under PR-02.
